Each term is a quarter of the term before it. In other words, each term is $\maroonD{\dfrac14}$ times the term before it.

| $\footnotesize\maroonC{\times \dfrac14\,\Large\curvearrowright}$ | | $\footnotesize\maroonC{\times \dfrac14\,\Large\curvearrowright}$ | | 
:-: |  :-: | :-: | :-: | :-: | 
$128,$ | | $32,$ | | $8$
